async function save(x) {}
async function isFree(x) {
	return x > 2;
}
async function more(i) {
	return i < 3;
}
const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));

// CASE one_decl_plain expect=fire
async function a1(items) {
	for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i++) {
		await save(items[i]);
	}
}

// CASE two_decl_plain expect=fire
async function a2(items) {
	for (let i = 0, n = items.length; i < n; i++) {
		await save(items[i]);
	}
}

// CASE three_decl_plain expect=fire
async function a3(items) {
	for (let i = 0, n = items.length, step = 1; i < n; i += step) {
		await save(items[i]);
	}
}

// CASE empty_init_plain expect=fire
async function a4(items) {
	let i = 0;
	for (; i < items.length; i++) {
		await save(items[i]);
	}
}

// CASE empty_update_plain expect=fire
async function a5(items) {
	for (let i = 0; i < items.length; ) {
		await save(items[i]);
		i++;
	}
}

// CASE var_two_decl_plain expect=fire
async function a6(items) {
	for (var i = 0, n = items.length; i < n; i++) {
		await save(items[i]);
	}
}

// CASE two_decl_braceless expect=fire
async function a7(items) {
	for (let i = 0, n = items.length; i < n; i++) await save(items[i]);
}

// CASE two_decl_asi_braceless expect=fire
async function a8(items) {
	for (let i = 0, n = items.length; i < n; i++) await save(items[i]);
}

// CASE two_decl_regex_literal expect=fire
async function a9(names) {
	for (let i = 0, n = names.length; i < n; i++) {
		await save(names[i].replace(/'/g, ""));
	}
}

// CASE two_decl_template_brace expect=fire
async function a10(names) {
	for (let i = 0, n = names.length; i < n; i++) {
		await save(`{${names[i]}`);
	}
}

// CASE two_decl_early_return expect=pass
async function b1(ids) {
	for (let i = 0, n = ids.length; i < n; i++) {
		if (await isFree(ids[i])) return ids[i];
	}
	return -1;
}

// CASE two_decl_braced_break expect=pass
async function b2(ids) {
	let found = -1;
	for (let i = 0, n = ids.length; i < n; i++) {
		if (await isFree(ids[i])) {
			found = ids[i];
			break;
		}
	}
	return found;
}

// CASE empty_update_reverse_return expect=pass
async function b3(ids) {
	for (let i = ids.length; i-- > 0; ) {
		if (await isFree(ids[i])) return ids[i];
	}
	return -1;
}

// CASE two_decl_retry_sleep expect=pass
async function b4(call) {
	for (let attempt = 0, delay = 200; attempt < 5; attempt++, delay *= 2) {
		try {
			return await call();
		} catch (e) {
			await sleep(delay);
		}
	}
	throw new Error("failed");
}

// CASE two_decl_braceless_switch expect=fire
async function c1(events) {
	for (let i = 0, n = events.length; i < n; i++)
		switch (events[i].type) {
			case "save":
				await save(events[i]);
				break;
			default:
				await save(events[i]);
		}
}

// CASE for_of_inner_break_outer_await expect=fire
async function c2(orders) {
	for (const order of orders) {
		for (const line of order.lines) {
			if (line.void) break;
		}
		await save(order);
	}
}

// CASE two_decl_inner_break_outer_await expect=fire
async function c3(orders) {
	for (let i = 0, n = orders.length; i < n; i++) {
		for (const line of orders[i].lines) {
			if (line.void) break;
		}
		await save(orders[i]);
	}
}

// CASE for_of_callback_return_outer_await expect=fire
async function c4(orders) {
	for (const order of orders) {
		const lines = order.lines.filter((line) => {
			if (!line) return false;
			return line.qty > 0;
		});
		await save({ order, lines });
	}
}

// CASE two_decl_callback_return_outer_await expect=fire
async function c5(orders) {
	for (let i = 0, n = orders.length; i < n; i++) {
		const lines = orders[i].lines.filter(function (line) {
			return line.qty > 0;
		});
		await save(lines);
	}
}

// CASE for_of_switch_return_is_exit expect=pass
async function c6(events) {
	for (const evt of events) {
		switch (evt.type) {
			case "stop":
				return evt;
			default:
				await save(evt);
		}
	}
	return null;
}

// CASE infinite_for_worker expect=pass
async function d1(queue) {
	for (;;) {
		const job = await queue.next();
		if (!job) break;
		await save(job);
	}
}

// CASE infinite_for_nested_per_item expect=fire
async function d2(queue) {
	for (;;) {
		const batch = await queue.next();
		for (const item of batch) {
			await save(item);
		}
	}
}

// CASE while_true_nested_per_item expect=fire
async function d3(queue) {
	while (true) {
		const batch = await queue.next();
		for (const item of batch) {
			await save(item);
		}
	}
}

// CASE comment_header_no_loop expect=pass
async function e1(items) {
	// for (let i = 0, n = items.length; i < n; i++) {
	//   await save(items[i]);
	// }
	await save(items);
}

// CASE string_header_no_loop expect=pass
async function e2(items) {
	const doc = "for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {";
	await save(doc);
}

// CASE two_decl_cond_empty_body expect=fire
async function f1() {
	for (let i = 0, j = 1; await more(i + j); i++);
}

// CASE one_decl_update_empty_body expect=fire
async function f2() {
	for (let i = 0; i < 4; await save(i), i++);
}

// CASE one_decl_update_braced_body expect=fire
async function f3() {
	for (let i = 0; i < 4; await save(i), i++) {}
}

// CASE two_decl_nested_inner_per_item expect=fire
async function g1(groups) {
	for (let g = 0, n = groups.length; g < n; g++) {
		for (const item of groups[g]) {
			await save(item);
		}
	}
}

// CASE labeled_continue expect=fire
async function g2(groups) {
	outer: for (const group of groups) {
		for (const item of group) {
			if (!item) continue outer;
			await save(item);
		}
	}
}

// CASE for_await_stream expect=pass
async function h1(stream) {
	for await (const chunk of stream) {
		await save(chunk);
	}
}

// CASE for_await_nested_per_item expect=fire
async function h3(stream) {
	for await (const chunk of stream) {
		for (const row of chunk) {
			await save(row);
		}
	}
}

// CASE nullish_assign_in_loop expect=fire
async function i1(items, opts) {
	for (const item of items) {
		opts.retries ??= 3;
		await save(item);
	}
}

// CASE nullish_string_in_loop expect=fire
async function i2(items) {
	for (const item of items) {
		await save(`${item} ??= default`);
	}
}

// CASE lazy_cache_once expect=pass
async function i3(items, cache) {
	for (const item of items) {
		cache.client ??= await connect();
		use(cache.client, item);
	}
}
async function connect() {}
function use() {}
